problem: Wake listener repeatedly answered itself after audible playback. The last bad interaction was promoted from transcript 'oh man'.

changes.change: Removed 'oh man' from probable wake fallback transcript whitelist.
Added configurable cooldown_seconds argument sourced from MIM_WAKE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.
Set MIM_WAKE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=45 for the user service.

training_lesson.rule: Do not treat ambiguous post-playback recognition fragments as wake intent unless a strong wake phrase or operator-directed phrase is present.
training_lesson.future_recovery_action: When repeated wake responses occur, inspect the last transcript, remove weak fallback matches, increase cooldown, and verify status remains listening after one quiet interval.
